notes:
Tasks: Assigned to me, Assigned by me, In the loop and All tasks now sit in one row — slide it sideways for the rest. Search and Filter are icons at the top right; tap the magnifier and type. Finished tasks moved into Filter → Completed tasks (hide them, show them in Total, or show only them), and Filter can now pick who a task is assigned to on every list.

A task that is rejected now goes back to whoever assigned it, marked Rejected with the reasons. They can edit it and send it again (to the same person or someone else), keep it rejected, or delete it.

Delete many tasks at once: tap the tick box at the top of Tasks (or long-press a task), tick the others, then tap the bin. Everyone can do this for the tasks they set; a Super Admin for any task.

Points are no longer on the assign form; a Super Admin can give someone the Points permission to set them. Recurring tasks lost the extra Stop button — the switch pauses one, the bin deletes it.

Approvals: a new All button shows everything waiting on you, and every type shows a red count of what is pending. The approval chain boxes no longer stretch out when the chain is short.
